# schedule template event

The template event from which occurrences are generated — the anchor event carrying title, location, participants, and duration. Functional: one template per schedule.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/scheduleTemplateEvent>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:scheduleTemplateEvent`  

**Type:** `owl:FunctionalProperty`, `owl:ObjectProperty`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/calendar>
